name: How can I tell if my baseboards have water damage?

mainEntity.name: How can I tell if my baseboards have water damage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of water damage include discoloration, swelling, warping, crumbling, or a musty odor near the baseboards. You might also notice peeling paint or wallpaper on the wall directly above the baseboard. For a more thorough assessment, carefully pressing on the baseboard can reveal soft spots indicating rot. Catching these signs early helps limit the extent of damage and simplifies the repair process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for discoloration, swelling, warping, crumbling, musty odors, or soft spots in the baseboards to identify water damage.
